rounds.text: The most compelling evidence for the long-term potential of Guru Krupa Gems & Jewellery Ltd is its exceptional 50% compounded profit growth over the last decade [E12]. While recent performance has faced headwinds, this long-term track record demonstrates a proven ability to scale profitability significantly over time [E12]. Investors are currently paying only 1.69 times the book value for this capacity, which suggests the market has not fully priced in the company's historical ability to generate earnings [E2]. Furthermore, the 17% compounded profit growth over the last five years confirms that the business has maintained a strong growth trajectory for the majority of the last decade [E13]. Conceded: [E1], [E4], [E6], [E7], [E14], [E15], [E53]. The current market capitalisation of ₹ 42.0 Cr provides a small base that allows for significant upside potential should the company return to its historical growth rates [E3].
